title: PrivateEye Causal Failure Taxonomy & Attribution Analysis

taxonomy.trigger: DOM mutated asynchronously between visual observation capture and Playwright action dispatch.
taxonomy.detection_control: Local Ref Validation (`LocalRefValidator` verifies candidate exists on live DOM before click).
taxonomy.preventive_control: Dynamic element re-anchoring and polling for stable DOM frame.
taxonomy.recovery_control: Fresh reasoning re-capture (`ProgressState` triggers full screenshot and candidate rebuild).
taxonomy.residual_weakness: Client cannot freeze single-page application background event loop during model inference turn.

taxonomy.trigger: Network spinner or server latency delayed page transition beyond post-condition timeout (3.0s).
taxonomy.detection_control: Post-Condition Evaluator (`ActionSpecificPostCondition` monitors DOM mutation & URL transition).
taxonomy.preventive_control: Adaptive timeout escalation based on network idle heuristic.
taxonomy.recovery_control: Fresh reasoning verifies whether backend mutation settled, avoiding duplicate submit.
taxonomy.residual_weakness: Tradeoff between agent responsiveness and tolerating erratic remote network latency.

taxonomy.trigger: Action executed successfully by Playwright, but UI remained in unchanged state (e.g. disabled form submit).
taxonomy.detection_control: Progress Evaluator (`ProgressEvaluator` detects 0 DOM hash delta across consecutive turns).
taxonomy.preventive_control: Pre-execution input completeness check on required form fields.
taxonomy.recovery_control: Explicit `no_progress` prompt flag forces model to inspect preceding fields and rectify omissions.
taxonomy.residual_weakness: Client relies on model reasoning to diagnose why an enabled button produced no DOM mutation.

taxonomy.trigger: Model selected visually plausible secondary button instead of primary intended workflow target.
taxonomy.detection_control: Post-condition failure on subsequent step when expected destination page was not reached.
taxonomy.preventive_control: Selective Crop Verifier (`CropVerifier` computes top-2 visual candidate contrast margin).
taxonomy.recovery_control: Rollback / fresh reasoning with failed action history prevents re-selecting the wrong candidate.
taxonomy.residual_weakness: Small 3B multimodal model capacity limits nuanced instruction disambiguation in complex SaaS headers.

taxonomy.trigger: Two identically styled and labeled controls rendered simultaneously (safe abstention triggered).
taxonomy.detection_control: Confidence & Candidate Gating (margin < 0.10 flags ambiguous target).
taxonomy.preventive_control: Strict safe refusal (`ASK_USER`) avoids 50% catastrophic guessing error.
taxonomy.recovery_control: Human clarification resolves intention and resumes execution cleanly.
taxonomy.residual_weakness: Counted as autonomous task failure under strict 0-human-intervention benchmark rules.

taxonomy.trigger: Local Ollama inference turn exceeded 15.0s watchdog deadline during heavy GPU memory paging.
taxonomy.detection_control: Inference Watchdog (`WatchdogTimer` halts hanging HTTP connection).
taxonomy.preventive_control: KV-cache retention and VRAM allocation tuning.
taxonomy.recovery_control: Fail-closed safe abort (`SAFE_STOP`); zero corrupt or partially executed actions.
taxonomy.residual_weakness: Local consumer GPU hardware constraints introduce occasional tail latency spikes.
